findings.title: Resolve public evidence identities and actual flow ownership before allocation
findings.finding: The frozen packet deliberately leaves evidence identities unresolved. P09/P10/P12/P13 span all three templates, but ACT-09 is not a directory/system template owner in the frozen flow CSV. Borrowing its stream-control semantics cannot expand its INSTANCE ownership. The evidence grammar also lacks an independent pending-stream axis; giving every ordered pair the same active-stream tuple would collide, while inventing public INSTANCE or STATE identifiers would change authority.
findings.repair: For every FRAME/PROTOTYPE/ANNOTATION, record the allowed source INSTANCE and normalization, template, state, viewport, mode, one in-force stream, lineage, case references and export role. FLOW-NAVIGATION-SEARCH owns the navigation/directory family and FLOW-ERROR-OFFLINE-RECOVERY owns recovery. Distinguish reused ACT-09 behavior authority from the owning evidence instance. Resolve pair/branch identity through approved evidence-unit composition and annotation associations, without fabricated identifiers or duplicate evidence/export paths. An actual enlargement of approved owner/template associations needs a separately reviewed authority amendment; normalizing an existing permitted owner does not. Later identity candidates outside this packet receive no verdict here.

findings.title: Bind each copied action to its functional primitive rather than its source label
findings.finding: Source14:18 is an observed PRIM-015 base component, not a complete functional navigation, directory, Book, radio or Apply primitive. PRIM-015 is absent from the navigation/directory template primitive_dependencies. The owned-closed recipe uses that source for Menu but does not yet distinguish mechanical visual reuse from the required PRIM-002 functional evidence. A Label override or node rename cannot establish anatomy, variants, interaction/focus states or authorize a new primitive dependency.
findings.repair: Add source primitive, intended functional primitive, required anatomy/variants/states, owned component/control topology and evidence mapping per use. Treat14:18 as a mechanical starting source when constructing the approved Menu/Close/Book/control anatomy; separately inspect and map PRIM-002, PRIM-004, PRIM-014 and PRIM-001 as applicable. Preserve the source master. Do not claim PRIM-015 coverage on an unassigned template. A proposal to change accepted dependencies, anatomy or variants materially requires the project change/review/founder gate; no such change is necessary merely to copy a visual proxy and fulfill existing approved functional requirements.

findings.title: Select a finite native graph with explicit state matching, reset and overlay topology
findings.finding: All16 ordered pairs are logically present, but the packet has no concrete variant set, owned source of Apply behavior, selected action per edge, or component-state reset/matching policy. Figma shares previously interacted variants between matching components; this can carry an old active/pending variant into a correctly labelled destination. Top-level scroll sharing depends on identical names or a common slash prefix, whereas current evidence names differ across states/streams. Swap overlay also has no overlay-history Back step. These are documented provider behaviors, not observed qualifications of this file.
findings.repair: Specify each finite node/edge with template, active/pending pair, route/panel/query/recovery context, fixture outcome, trigger scope, one allowed action, exact symbolic owned control and destination, reset policy and entry point. Use an owned variant set or explicit owned frame branches that can route Apply by the chosen pending state without paid conditionals. Separate no-op diagonal paths from change-success/failure fixtures. Bind matching nested scroll containers/parent names and authoritative resulting component defaults without violating evidence-ID grammar or editing protected sources. Choose overlay Open/Swap/Close and explicit canonical navigation behavior; do not use Back to pretend Swap reverses an overlay. After bounded authorization, qualify real Presentation paths for nonzero scroll, open-panel preservation, return, selection-only actions, refusal and repeated transitions; annotations can supplement focus semantics but cannot replace claimed observed Presentation behavior.

Shared recovery specimens have no stream-specific host identity. Associate every P01-P22 sequence/branch with those units and the four streams. Classify P04 directory-result candidates as supplemental examples, not navigation trigger/destination proof. Resolve navigation closed/focus and directory closed/focus, narrow/tablet/wide annotations, recovery context embeddings and complete viewport minima explicitly. Respect minimum_evidence and qualitative stress/reading/focus requirements without multiplying an unnecessary full Cartesian product or treating216 as a copy target.

findings.title: Make source admission and owned-copy discovery a staged, reviewable operation
findings.finding: The guards correctly forbid guessed aliases and protected-master writes. The14-host/94-control report is non-atomic, and the additional native selections cover only four directory controls, one stream master/text descendant and one general-action master. They do not supply an admissible whole selected tree, all retained styles/fonts/tokens/reactions, exact owned component-set isolation, or a recoverable write procedure.
findings.repair: Before external release, define a source-read admission record for each selected source with file/page, actual ID/type/parent chain, required descendant/property/style/font/token/reaction checks, drift refusals and native inspection method. Define a pre-approved symbolic ownership manifest and bounded isolated copy operation, then a post-copy discovery/checkpoint mapping of actual root/component/control/annotation IDs before wiring. Do not demand impossible advance actual new IDs and do not bypass absent guard data via hidden APIs, capped MCP, composer retries or paid features. Preserve snapshots/native archives, source preservation checks and applicable cleanup/restore authority. Native editable export integrity alone remains distinct from tested restore and _EXIT.

findings.title: Bind concrete warning/extension stages and terminal/unknown inspection entries
findings.finding: The recipe faithfully retains30-minute inactivity, at least20seconds to act, at leastten extension opportunities, beginning-of-process notice/More time, current versus historical deadlines, immutable-intent reconciliation and terminal End. The three native More time hits are notes rather than controls. Exact host stages, control bindings, acknowledged/current/unknown lifetime displays, pending reconciliation and repeated inspection entries remain absent; a written repeat_inspection string is not an executed ten-opportunity design sequence.
findings.repair: Select approved source/owned host recipes and exact action, annotation, evidence-allocation and flow-entry bindings for initial notice, warning, applied, pending, stale, refused, unknown-deadline, background return and terminal outcomes. Record a visibly synthetic repeated-loop/stage method and ten inspected opportunities without variables, fabricated credentials or actual clocks; acknowledged labels must not imply that an older receipt supersedes current truth. Specify ordinary End while extension is pending, late reply after terminal End/expiry, and explicit B05 new-session boundary. Keep real timing, race, DOM/live-region, keyboard/touch/AT and privacy enforcement as later runtime evidence.
